entities.summary: Syed Ahmad Khan, a notable figure in the history of Pakistan, associated with British Raj and Pakistan Movement (1858–1930). Preceded by Khilafat Movement and All-India Muslim League. Their legacy influenced All-India Muslim League founded at Dhaka and Muslim League.
